draw_backup.description: Same predicted draw payoff becomes positive at a network leaf but remains negative at a terminal leaf.
draw_backup.note: With max_plies=2 every child is nonterminal but will draw after one further quiet initial-position move. This isolates backup semantics, not trained-model strength.

arena_gate.note: The probability is an illustrative exact binomial calculation, not an estimate for actual correlated games with draws.

historical_gumbel.description: Sequential Halving eliminates candidates using in-flight visits before their Q values are returned.
historical_gumbel.note: This proves a defect in the removed implementation; it does not establish the cause of previous training outcomes or predict a corrected implementation's strength.
